notes: Upload now sanitizes every SKU / description / customer name / memo: strips ASCII control characters (which break XML 1.0), collapses embedded newlines/tabs to spaces, and trims whitespace before escaping. The built XML is also validated locally with ElementTree before being sent to QuickBooks, so character-level XML breakage is caught with the exact offending location instead of QuickBooks's generic 'parsing error' (-2147220480). When the SDK rejects the upload, the FULL request XML is now logged (no 8 KB truncation) so the offending row is visible in Log > Open Log File.
